APU in Malaysia was a university where I felt the future of tech 🤖

🏫 Day 2 Visit

On day 2 of the university visits, I went to Asia Pacific University (APU).

🙋 Our Guide

The one who showed us around the school was a 19-year-old boy.

He is Malaysian, but his English was very fluent, and he was cool.

He was so mature that I could not believe he was 19.

🟩 NVIDIA Lab

APU had NVIDIA equipment.

🧠 The Server

He also told us about the server inside.

It seems NVIDIA chips are inside it.

I forgot the unit, but was it 100 billion tokens?

Anyway, I think he explained that it can run things like ChatGPT and Claude a lot.

✨ Sparkling Eyes

Besides NVIDIA, there was a place to learn Cisco, and of course AWS and Google Cloud.

Anyway, this APU is really strong in technology.

It felt like you could do anything related to tech.

I felt the future a lot, and I thought it was a really good university.

My eyes really sparkled.

It is a university that I really wanted to go to.

I went for my sister's university visit, but it was very attractive, and everything was cool.

I thought it was a very attractive university for people who want to go into tech.

🛏 The Dorm Room

They also showed us an APU dorm room.

📍 Good Location

They showed us the dorm room, and the APU dorm room was also very clean.

And it is on the campus, so the location is good.
